node.title: H3 unordered-product cutoff-12 candidate compiler
node.statement: The monic unordered shifted-product polynomial Ucal_n lies in Z[T], has degree n(n-1)/2, and satisfies Ucal_n^2=Pcal_n Delta_n. Its cutoff-12 derivative ideal, saturated by the inverse selector (T-1)Y=1, has exactly the odd-prime support of characteristics with a nonidentity unordered product fiber of multiplicity at least 13. Every nonidentity P>=25 fiber is retained; the sole selected cutoff-boundary false-positive profile is U=13,D=2,P=24. At n=8192 this replaces degree 67,092,481 and 25 ordered generators by degree 33,550,336 and 13 unordered generators. No official-scale algorithm, factorization, or DSP8 close is claimed.
